title: Delivery pulled forward to less than the fabric lead time, Japanese yyyy/mm/dd date
subject: KT-0612 earlier shipment request
body:
Dear Karthik-san,

Our Tokyo store opening has moved earlier. Could you bring the ex-factory date for KT-0612 forward to 2027/01/15? Quantities and price stay as in Amendment 1.

We understand this is a big request, so please tell us honestly if it is possible.

Best regards,
Haruka Mori
Kumo Textile Co., Ltd.
